notes: Fiscal year ends Saturday nearest June 30 (FQ4'26 ended 2026-06-27; FQ1'22 ended 2021-10-02). FQ4 values derived as 10-K FY minus 9M; FY26 quarters sum to 3,014.0 = 10-K. FY26 = TTM: OCF 751.4, capex 451.3 (15.0%), FCF 300.1 (10.0%). Net cash = cash 2,043.5 + ST inv 694.9 - debt carrying value 1,637.4 (1,596.9 current converts + 40.5 LT) at 6/27/26. heavy_dilution (judgment call): shares outstanding rose from 69.9M (FY25 10-K cover, 2025-08-12) to 89.7M (FY26 10-K cover, 2026-08-14), +28% YoY, mainly from equitization of convertible notes (FQ4 $7.8B non-cash extinguishment loss) plus Series A convertible preferred issued March 2026; diluted weighted shares 69.3M (FQ3'25) -> 96.2M (FQ3'26). This dilution retired debt rather than funding losses. ttm_pe = $1,085.42 / FY26 non-GAAP diluted EPS $8.67 (TTM = fiscal year ended 2026-06-27; reported FY figure, which uses 90.2M FY non-GAAP shares; the sum of quarters $1.10+$1.67+$2.37+$3.23 = $8.37 would give ~129.7x). GAAP FY26 was a loss of $92.96/share from the $7.8B non-cash convert extinguishment loss. eps_growth_ttm_pct = $8.67 vs FY25 $2.06. market_cap_musd from SA $97.4B; it may not fully reflect the Series A convertible preferred.
